sources.title: StanceEval-2026 | Arabic Stance Detection Shared Task
sources.snippet: StanceEval-2026 is a shared task on stance detection in Arabic social media. Given a tweet and a target, systems must determine whether the writer's stance is Favor, Against, or None — across both seen and unseen targets, using the multi-label Mawqif-v2 dataset.

sources.title: StanceEval-2026: Track 1 - Arabic Stance Detection (Seen Targets)
sources.snippet: StanceEval-2026: Track 1 — Arabic Stance Detection (Seen Targets) StanceEval-2026 is a shared task on Arabic stance detection using the Mawqif-v2 dataset. Track 1 evaluates models on targets observed during training. Task Description Given a post and a target, participants must classify the stance expressed in the post toward the target.
